en: A black‑and‑white, slightly damaged postcard-like print showing a wide street or square bordered by large institutional or civic buildings in a European architectural style. On the left is an older, castle‑like structure with a steep roof, small round corner tower, and simpler facades, connected to adjoining multi‑story buildings. Leafless trees and a low wall surround a park-like open area, with a single streetlamp in the foreground. On the right is a more ornate, 19th‑century neoclassical or historicist building with arched windows and a rusticated ground floor, facing an open, largely empty street. The two halves of the image appear to be from a panoramic photograph mounted on a backing card; the top and right edges are torn, revealing blank paper beneath. Handwritten text appears faintly along the bottom margin, possibly a place name and date, but is not fully legible.
